purpose: Supplement the canonical Antigravity board with older Gemini/TESSERA/MERIDIAN/pro-capital/flash-market/idle-hands Kaggriculture posts so all surfaced Gemini lineage terminates in a current V4 disposition without spawning another controller.
convergence_rules: This file extends the sole gemini-antigravity-convergence authority; it is not a second coverage root or runtime controller.
Historical PRs and Slack posts are provenance only; canonical_evidence must resolve to current regular files under candidates/v4.
Private rival inventory is never reconstructed from public cash or mass balance unless a separately authenticated source theorem proves the exact bound.
Negative and cold historical experiments remain represented so failed Gemini ideas cannot be silently resurrected as novelty.
Current descendants supersede historical literal policies when they preserve the useful mechanism with stricter source and field custody.

canonical_overrides.reason: Merged PR #13018 is the stronger descendant of the original mean-only baseline: it retains exact per-shop ratios, adds unlock-horizon and town-center demand, and exposes low-quantile NPC absorption headroom without granting crop-choice or sale-timing authority.
canonical_overrides.best_form: Treat town demand as a distribution, not a static tier. Use exact per-shop drain, unlock horizons, town-center demand and low-quantile panel absorption headroom; keep rival/player supply and sale timing outside this oracle.

entries.literal_claim: Hold an identical committed prefix, then condition the suffix on newly observed shared inventory to beat the static complete plan.
entries.best_form: Preserve the complete-plan recourse machinery only as negative research ancestry. PR #10004 reached a real WOOL suffix, but the development panel had static and adaptive variants each lose 7 own cash per seat versus the integrated control; no strength promotion survived.
entries.next_gate: Reopen only with a current-native identical-prefix recourse carrier that changes reached actions and produces positive paired both-seat economics against the current integrated control.

entries.literal_claim: Exploit short-lived town-demand price windows with fixed-clock market actions.
entries.best_form: Keep the timing edge but bind it to exact deterministic town/shop drains and current public inventory. TOWNSELL proves the post-drain premium for an already-authored sale under zero intervening rival flow; it is not a speculative fixed-clock merchant.
entries.next_gate: Any runtime timing change must compose with the incumbent seller, authenticate intervening rival/public flow, engage on exact returned actions, and clear paired both-seat economics.

entries.literal_claim: Infer cross-product rival hidden shed inventory from public cash and market mass balance, then optimize maximin play against the reconstructed state.
entries.best_form: Use only authenticated public facts: rival farm tiles and standing yield, public money, public market inventory/prices, and known town drain. PARALLAX deliberately does not read or infer rival private shed inventory. No exact current-V4 cross-product cash certificate was recovered, so private-state reconstruction stays blocked rather than guessed.
entries.next_gate: Reopen only with a source-bound theorem that maps public cash/market transitions to a nontrivial exact hidden-inventory bound without using private observation fields, followed by current-native predictive validation.

entries.literal_claim: Suppress excess HIRE rows when observable crop-service demand is low.
entries.best_form: Retain the repaired E20 donor only with executable-prefix semantics: engine-inert market suffix HIRE rows cannot consume the allowance. The donor remains identity when disabled and does not authorize the historically rejected broad economics lane.
entries.next_gate: A production consumer must prove exact current composition, natural reachability and paired economics without stranding coupled capital purchases; no blanket HIRE suppression.

entries.literal_claim: Spend otherwise idle worker actions on CARE to bank future animal output.
entries.best_form: CARE is a real resource-neutral service lever, but value is delayed and storage-sensitive. Current S8/AFTERCARE/CARESAT descendants require fed animals, later production, held-cap and shed-cap safety; fixed continuations show extra product can crowd out more valuable cargo.
entries.next_gate: Admit CARE only from a current composed action when a later fed production boundary exists and storage/carry opportunity cost is bounded, then require paired both-seat economics.

entries.literal_claim: Replace an idle or redundant FEED action with useful animal service rather than wasting the worker turn.
entries.best_form: The historical 7,192-FEED census found zero animals already fed at callback entry, but that does not kill same-turn ordered redundancy. Current W2 proves an earlier actor can FEED and make a later same-site FEED redundant; the source component may rewrite only that certified later FEED to CARE and remains promotion-gated.
entries.next_gate: Measure natural current-V4 ordered-FEED opportunities and full-game storage-aware economics; callback-entry zero counts alone cannot certify coldness.

entries.gemini_label: Gemini idle-hands buy WHEAT / buy GEESE
entries.literal_claim: Use idle capacity to buy feed or additional geese so future worker slots become productive.
entries.best_form: Do not attach purchases to generic idle detection. WHEAT and animal acquisition belong to existing feed/procurement and HOMESTEAD/HERDSCALE economics because every new unit creates cash, placement, service, carry/shed and sale obligations. Idle hands are evidence of spare labor, not proof an acquisition pays.
entries.next_gate: Route any acquisition proposal through the existing current-native cash/service/capacity authorities and require the purchase to improve paired economics; never buy solely because a worker was idle.

entries.literal_claim: Convert a spare late action into WHEAT fertilization when it can realize extra crop value.
entries.best_form: Use the current WF1 source/current-native field descendant rather than a generic PASS rewrite. Its exact eight-cell gate changed returned actions first at step 647 and was positive in all eight cells, mean margin +143.25, while still explicitly withholding activation authority.
entries.next_gate: Repair/retain exact telemetry custody, widen the paired current-native panel and compose only through the existing WF1 owner; do not generalize the positive small gate into arbitrary fertilization.

entries.literal_claim: The recovered Gemini opening sequence is solvent with the originally claimed post-opening cash reserve.
entries.best_form: Keep the opening only as a solvency counterexample. The recovered arithmetic spends 882 from 1000 and leaves 118, not the claimed 498; do not revive the tape or infer opening strength from the incorrect reserve.
entries.next_gate: None for the literal tape. A new opener must be rebuilt from current engine costs and pass executable-prefix, solvency, service and paired economics gates.

entries.literal_claim: Promote productive LAND/ANIMAL capital earlier when sales can fund it.
entries.best_form: Keep the capital idea inside the existing early-capital authority and KESTREL lockstep admission. A proposal must preserve executable active rows and not sacrifice an original BUY_PRODUCT or other coupled operating obligation merely to move capital earlier.
entries.next_gate: Run the exact current checkout binding and measure natural early-capital changes versus KESTREL-admitted changes; nonzero admissions require paired both-seat economics.

entries.literal_claim: Classify the opponent as an EARLY_EXPANDER or AGGRESSIVE_MARKET_DUMPER and immediately mutate land/sale behavior from that label.
entries.best_form: Retire the mutually exclusive intent labels. Keep independent public facts—visible expansion, standing productive yield, price movement and known town drain—inside PARALLAX/market-pressure research; a rival can satisfy multiple witnesses and none proves hidden intent or private inventory.
entries.next_gate: Only source-bound continuous public features that add predictive value on held-out current games may feed existing decision owners; do not resurrect brittle opponent labels.

entries.literal_claim: Defer a SELL after a public price drop when future absorption can restore price.
entries.best_form: Preserve E11's public-price-drop lineage only with exact integer future town absorption; retire fractional absorption heuristics. TOWNSELL supplies the stronger deterministic theorem for moving an already-authored sale after a known intervening drain when rival flow is absent.
entries.next_gate: Any current seller consumer must authenticate the price-history chronology and intervening rival flow, then prove exact returned-action engagement and paired economics.

entries.gemini_label: Gemini final-day row-shed SELL ordering / STRATUM
entries.literal_claim: Order leading SELL rows by price impact of the units that can actually be filled from projected shed stock.
entries.best_form: Keep the canonical STRATUM current-ABI transform and its pressure-novel admission guard. Historical field evidence was strongly positive, but V4 must only admit ordering differences that survive the downstream canonical market-pressure transform; composition/current-field gates still own activation.
entries.next_gate: Materialize the exact current graph/postimage, prove the distinction survives final returned-action pressure composition, then run both-seat current-native economics before activation.

entries.literal_claim: Boost future market absorption by a fixed multiplier such as 1.5x when a relevant town shop exists.
entries.best_form: Retire the multiplier. Official inventory movement is integer and shop-instance-specific. Use exact unlocked-shop drain plus the DEMANDVEL distribution over unlock horizons/town-center demand; expected absorption never becomes sale or production authority by itself.
entries.next_gate: Consumers may use exact drain/headroom only as one state feature; any production/sale threshold change still requires current-native both-seat predictive and economic evidence.

entries.gemini_label: Gemini day-28/29 skips + terminal glut bleed remainder
entries.literal_claim: The unshipped remainder of the final-day Gemini lane should skip selected late actions and bleed glut inventory before terminal scoring.
entries.best_form: Preserve the lineage but do not invent semantics from the name. The shipped row-shed commit explicitly excluded day-28/29 skips and glut bleed, and no byte-exact source was recovered. Broad repeated late-sale evidence from #11731 was harmful and is a falsifier, not a substitute implementation.
entries.next_gate: Reopen only if exact historical semantics are recovered or a new source-derived terminal theorem is independently specified and passes current-native reachability/economics; no guessed day cutoff or blanket SELL.
